description: Rewrite LTX_PRO.py as the 'Modified Infinite Flow Engine' integrating LTX 2.3 models, Infinite Flow Engine classes, and PRO features. This is a complete file rewrite combining elements from Experiment_LTX23_TI2V_Distilled.ipynb.py (LTX 2.3 models + EXECUTE_NORMALIZED API + tensor_width_height helper + CLIP-delete-before-UNet strategy + civitai support + distilled LoRA), LTX2_InfiniteFlow_12Scene.py (VisionDescribeEngine, EasyPromptEngine, CharacterBible, generate_clip, InfiniteFlowEngine, concatenate_clips), and LTX2_Infinite_Flow_PRO_v2.py (camera LoRA mapping, build_shot_prompt_pro, adaptive anchor strength, enhanced negative prompt builder, motion guidance, voice sync).
steps: Create the complete new LTX_PRO.py file with 9 cells maintaining Colab structure. The file is approximately 2500-3000 lines.

CELL 1 - Environment Setup: Use current ComfyUI (not pinned Isi-dev branch) from Experiment_LTX23. Clone: comfyanonymous/ComfyUI, kijai/ComfyUI-KJNodes, city96/ComfyUI-GGUF, Lightricks/ComfyUI-LTXVideo. Install same pip packages as original. Include apt packages (aria2, ffmpeg).

CELL 2 - Model Downloads: Use LTX 2.3 model URLs from Experiment_LTX23: ltx-2.3-22b-dev-Q4_K_M.gguf (unsloth), gemma_3_12B_it_fp8_scaled.safetensors + GGUF fallback (gemma-3-12b-it-qat-UD-Q4_K_XL.gguf + mmproj-BF16.gguf), ltx-2.3-22b-dev_embeddings_connectors.safetensors, ltx-2.3-22b-dev_video_vae.safetensors, ltx-2.3-22b-dev_audio_vae.safetensors, ltx-2.3-spatial-upscaler-x2-1.0.safetensors, ltx-2.3-22b-distilled-lora-384.safetensors (mandatory distill LoRA). Keep IC LoRA downloads + camera LoRA downloads from original. Support 3 user LoRAs with civitai download support from Experiment_LTX23.

CELL 3 - Imports, helpers, all engine classes: Include model_download(), download_civitai_model(), download_lora(), get_value_at_index(), tensor_width_height() (from Experiment_LTX23), load_audio_vae_compat() (from Experiment_LTX23), pil_to_tensor(), tensor_to_pil(), load_image_tensor(), get_last_frame_tensor(), display_video(), save_video_from_components(), concatenate_clips(), import_custom_nodes(), cleanup_memory()/purge_vram(). Include full VisionDescribeEngine class from InfiniteFlow_12Scene. Include full EasyPromptEngine class with _NEG_BASE, _build_neg(), SYSTEM_PROMPT, _CLEAN_RE, all methods. Include CharacterBible class. Include PRO features: CAMERA_LORA_MAPPING, build_character_prompt_detailed(), get_character_consistency_prefix(), get_motion_guidance_prompt(), get_camera_lora_for_shot(), get_dialogue_for_shot_enhanced(), build_audio_atmosphere_prompt(), build_shot_prompt_pro(), calculate_adaptive_strength(), build_negative_prompt_enhanced().

CELL 4 - Configuration: EasyPrompt settings (LLM_MODEL, CREATIVITY, INVENT_DIALOGUE, BYPASS_EASY_PROMPT, LORA_TRIGGERS), Vision settings (USE_VISION, VISION_MODEL), display settings, PRO settings (USE_CHARACTER_LORAS, USE_MOTION_LORAS, USE_VOICE_SYNC, USE_ADAPTIVE_STRENGTH, ANCHOR_STRENGTH_HIGH/LOW, USE_NEGATIVE_PROMPT_EXPANSION, USE_PROMPT_WEIGHTING, INJECT_CHARACTER_EVERY_SHOT). Include example SCENE_JSON from PRO_v2.

CELL 5 - Character & LoRA configuration: CHARACTER_IMAGE_PATH, CHARACTER_STRENGTH, CHARACTER_CONSISTENCY_MODE, CHARACTER_NAME, CHARACTER_DESCRIPTION. IC LoRA config (IC_LORA, IC_LORA_STRENGTH). Camera LoRA config (CAMERA_LORA, CAMERA_LORA_STRENGTH). User LoRA slots (3 user LoRAs with strength). Memory/performance flags (USE_SAGE_ATTENTION, USE_CHUNK_FF, PURGE_VRAM_AFTER_MODELS). PRO mode flags.

CELL 6 - Video generation configuration: USER_INPUT, IMAGE_PATH, IMAGE_STRENGTH, POSITIVE_PROMPT, NEGATIVE_PROMPT. Resolution (WIDTH, HEIGHT, FRAMES, FPS). Seed settings. Model filenames pointing to LTX 2.3 versions. Sigma schedules (pass1/pass2). Tiled VAE config. Output prefix. USE_SCENE_CONTINUITY.

CELL 7 - Define generate_clip(): This is the critical function. Follow VRAM sequence from InfiniteFlow_12Scene: (1) Load CLIP via DualCLIPLoader with safetensors Gemma primary + GGUF Gemma fallback from Experiment_LTX23, (2) CLIPTextEncode + ConditioningZeroOut + LTXVConditioning with EXECUTE_NORMALIZED, (3) DELETE CLIP to free VRAM, (4) Load UNet (UnetLoaderGGUF with ltx-2.3-22b-dev-Q4_K_M.gguf), (5) Apply distilled LoRA FIRST (ltx-2.3-22b-distilled-lora-384.safetensors) then IC/camera/user LoRAs, (6) Latent preparation using tensor_width_height() with latent_w = max(1, resized_w // 2) from Experiment_LTX23, (7) Pass 1 (euler + ManualSigmas), (8) Pass 2 (spatial upscale + gradient_estimation), (9) Delete UNet, (10) Decode video (tiled or standard), (11) Decode audio, (12) Save via CreateVideo. Support both I2V and T2V modes.

CELL 8 - InfiniteFlowEngine + Storyboard runner: Include the InfiniteFlowEngine class from InfiniteFlow_12Scene (adapted to use LTX 2.3 generate_clip). Include run_storyboard() function from original LTX_PRO.py adapted for the new generate_clip(). Include STORY_BEATS example list. Include JSON-based storyboard parsing from PRO_v2 (building STORYBOARD from SCENE_JSON).
CELL 9 - Run cell: Support both single-clip mode and storyboard/infinite-flow mode. Include error handling with quick-fix references. Support AUTO_INCREMENT_SEED.
